review_corrections: Initial trace ran on a shallow clone: calib_real_drill.json and fx1_eval_lifecycle_audit.json were wrongly treated as unrecoverable and acknowledged as mutations in a new epoch; that unpushed stamp was dropped and both were restored instead (c036dee9d retag+reseal, 766a29ab9 reseal).
provenance_gaps entries for four receipts were removed: their git_revisions exist as refs/tags/attic/receipt-provenance/* and resolve as not_ancestor notes.

Second independent review: (1) the first restore commit message called both c036dee9d and 766a29ab9 post-stamp rewrites; only c036dee9d was (766a29ab9 lost a merge race, see restored_receipts note); (2) the calibration_audit.v1 drift ack claimed both members dispatch the deep contract; only calib_real_drill.json does (calibration_audit.json is kind calibration_audit); (3) the mid_dark_amzn quarantine reason omitted that 7151c567 also inserted live_pnl_claim; (4) cost_aware why_restored had been copied from forward_record. All four were corrected before push.

Third independent review (no blockers): the PR-only gates were skipped in CI whenever make evidence-audit failed, which it does on inherited drift, so the evidence job's later steps now run with !cancelled(); a re-add under another case or Unicode spelling escaped the resurrection rule (names are now folded); an unstamped resurrection was admissible (now member_resurrected_live); the ack gate ignored unknown corpus keys (now epoch_ack_unknown_corpus); the standalone script accepted duplicate keys in epoch files (now epoch_receipt_invalid, as in the library). While re-checking unstamped receipts before stamping, p0_evidence_inventory_v1.json was found to fail admission; an earlier unpushed stamp had included it, and it is now quarantined instead.

Fourth independent review (no blockers): the quarantine registry could grow in the same change that adds a receipt (now the quarantine-gate PR rule: new entries must pin bytes the base already had, and an admission_honesty_gap entry must be an unstamped base file); epoch-consistency aborted at the local-only data/metadata chain on clean checkouts, leaving 21 corpora unproven (now skipped by the same rule verify-repo uses); the evidence job's 10-minute timeout could not fit every gate (now 25); the honesty-gap pin is checked against the classified bytes themselves; name folding also drops NTFS trailing dots and spaces; the count above said five where it is four.

After the first merge, the recorded jewel-drift baseline (38 entries, identical to the then-base) was superseded: main re-pinned the jewels, so the same claim is now measured against main's tip (1 entry). The docs were updated to say so.

Fifth independent review (MiniMax-M3 over the full diff and gate logs; every claim was re-run locally before acting): the base-comparison gates (epoch-consistency, epoch-ack-gate, quarantine-gate and the admission diff) ran only on pull requests although commits land directly on main, so they now also run on push events against the pre-push tip (github.event.before), and docs and docstrings call them base gates; the standalone verify_epoch_chain.py crashed with KeyError on a corpus with no valid epoch receipt (now no_epoch_receipts / no_valid_epoch_receipts, exit 1, with a regression test); integration_with_main said the code-corpus drift was all main's, but this repair's own edits add to it; the docs' honesty-bar count was recounted against the receipts head (of the 382 verified, unregistered members the head stamps, 338 are claim receipts beside 44 epoch receipts; 170 of the 338 lack a required stamp, 143 of them only live_pnl_claim: false). Claims that did not reproduce were not acted on: evidence_audit already passes the raw bytes; the corpus_real_drill ack matches git show b07640432; the p0 honesty-gap pin matches its bytes; forks already fail epoch_fork; the .dsh-24x7 require-stamped policy agrees between CORPORA and the Makefile. Baselining main's McCabe excess in superpower.py was declined: that would widen a baseline for debt this repair did not add.

Sixth independent review (MiniMax-M3 judge, CI, honesty and devil's-advocate passes; every claim re-run locally before acting): epoch-consistency read the base heads pin through a pipe whose failure the loop ignored, so a base whose pin was missing or unreadable skipped all 28 chains and passed (reproduced with probe base commits in a scratch object store); it now fails closed, as admission-gate already did, with a regression test that fails on the old target; the docs now say how the honesty-bar figures are counted and that the head's 382 verified, unregistered members include 44 epoch receipts. Claims that did not reproduce were not acted on: GitHub's push payload gives the previous tip as before on a force-push (the all-zero SHA only when the push creates the ref), and a failed base fetch fails the step under the default bash -e shell, so a force-push cannot skip the base gates silently; a merge-commit push still compares against main's pre-push tip; the push-event gates cannot turn main's evidence job red, because it already fails at make evidence-audit on main's last completed push run (3267, 029211639).
